notes.title: Current status of Webstore Mogul
notes.content:
Hello future Webstore Mogul!
The last few months have been turbulent. As a solo developer, it's not always easy to focus fully on your own game when you have a full-time job on the side.

But development has continued nonetheless. There is no exact release date yet, but we are close.


So, what has been done over the last few months?

Labour shortage
Running your own online shop can be stressful, especially if you want to be at the top.

So that you don't have to do this completely on your own, you can now hire employees to help you store your products.

Later, of course, more jobs will be added so that employees can also process orders.


New product types
Packing the same products all the time can get boring. That's why new products have been added.

Among other things, there is also a new product type: freezer items. These must be stored in a refrigerator and cannot be placed in normal racks. 

More products and types will follow later, of course.


Was that a bird?
To make the time between orders a little more enjoyable, I have added some small sounds to lighten the atmosphere a little. 


A new courier
You now have the option of choosing a shipping provider for your shop. These have different prices for e.g. a parcel or express delivery. You will have to find out which one suits you best.


New start
The start of the game is now more structured and simpler. Creating your own shop now follows a clear line, making it even easier for you to get started.


QOL Changes
Express delivery for products is now selectable.

Repeating marketplace orders.

Customer reviews have been improved.

UI design has been revised.

Throwing for boxes has been added.

Tutorial steps with a specific path goal have been made more visually visible.


I hope you are looking forward to the game. A lot of time and effort has gone into it, and I am delighted to be able to present it soon!

ReDz

notes.title: The demo is now playable + new languages
notes.content:
Hello future webstore mogul

The demo of Webstore Mogul has finally been released. Now you can get an insight into what the path to Webstore Mogul feels like! I hope you enjoy the little demo. 


New languages added
As there was a growing demand for it, I set to work on the translation immediately after publication. The majority of the game should now be translated and is playable in German, French and Spanish. If you still find texts that are not translated, please post them in the Steam forum or use Discord. If you want more languages, write them to me as well.


Sound problems fixed
A few sound problems were reported, and there was also a request for sound for the player steps. These have now been added and a problem with the music setting should be fixed. 
I realised by chance that there were problems with copyright claims. The music is actually free to use, but is sometimes claimed automatically. If you as a Youtuber/Streamer have such problems, please contact me!

2 New window sizes
For those of you who have spent too much money on large monitors, here are the right sizes.
I have added 3840x2160 and 3440x1440 and tried to test them. If you notice any errors, please take a picture and send it to me and I'll fix it.

That should be it for the first little patch, I hope you enjoy it and feel free to write me a little review.

See you then! 
ReDz

notes.title: Webstore Mogul status report #02 Interact System, Demo, New year
notes.content:
Hello future webstore mogul

For the last time in 2024, I would like to give you an insight into the current state of development. In the last weeks and months I have worked on many things that don't seem big at first but take a lot of time. I've added the save and load system and am constantly expanding it, which is a rather annoying thing that requires a lot of work and certainly still contains bugs. But I'm quite happy with it for now.


Another very important thing that needs a lot of fine tuning is the algorithm that calculates how many orders a player can and will receive per day. I won't go into too much detail here, but just to give you an overview of what's involved: 
Product price 
Product variety 
Shop rating
Shop page
Time of day
And more.

But now for a few visual things. I have COMPLETELY overhauled the system for processing orders. The old one was too static for me, nothing exciting and it wasn't fun either. The new system is much more interactive in almost every step. You now have to choose the size of the box, sort the products into the box, close the flaps and stick the appropriate shipping label on it. How do you like the new system?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110976/8687622a543c3caabbf437643c65e544f2291468.gif

The general design of the computer UI has also been revised, I have now made it much brighter which is hopefully more appealing. I'm still not 100% satisfied, but it should be good for now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110976/1dc650e20222e579f0071d7268d41294263742d7.jpg

Also new is the level system, which should give the player a further incentive. Various tasks, such as completing orders or packing boxes, earn EXP. As you level up, you unlock new product licences and furniture. 

Finally, the most important thing. After many adjustments recently, I am currently preparing everything to be able to (hopefully) present a playable demo of Webstore Mogul in January. I want to finally give you the opportunity to experience the game. The demo will also include almost all content, except for the employee function and not all product categories. Are you looking forward to the demo ?

Then it remains for me to say, happy new year and see you next year in Webstore Mogul!

notes.title: Webstore Mogul status report #01 Employee management
notes.content:
Hello future webstore mogul

in order to involve you more in the development of the game, I would like to create status reports so that you know what the current state of ‘Webstore Mogul’ is. Many functions have already been programmed and now need performance improvements, balance adjustments or a design overhaul. Especially the design is not finalised yet, so it still needs adjustments in all directions. Here you can give feedback, generally to everything you see. 

Today we start with the status of the employees. An important aspect of the game, which extends to many sub-elements. That's why today I only want to talk about hiring new employees and managing them. 

The first thing to know about employees is that they have different skills, characteristics, working hours and salary expectations, which is why they can be interesting for different jobs. So I want to ensure that an employee who is responsible for the warehouse because their skills are high can still be used for something completely different. Of course, the employee will then be significantly worse at the other job, but it should be possible. What do you think of this possibility? 

In the picture below you can see a possible candidate. The important information such as name, age, working hours and of course the skills and characteristics should be listed there. As I said, the design is not yet finalised.

There will be a negotiation for the salary. You have to offer the candidate what they want, otherwise you won't be able to hire them.  Every candidate's salary expectations are different and you need to find out the minimum amount you can offer them. There is currently no event that is triggered if you offer far too little or too little several times. Can you imagine something good coming out of this?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110976/84373a26821a29d69193dd8cebb9209ba23982b8.gif

If you have now hired employees, you can of course manage them. I would like to offer a cool, detailed but also manageable function for planning working hours. In the picture below you can see how I have currently implemented it. You have a line there for each employee you have hired, where you can say with one click when the employee should start work. The exact working time is then calculated based on the hours worked. Here you have to be a little careful later, depending on the employee's characteristics, they may not like working at night or too early in the morning.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110976/9d89a591ab9d86719dc90b47ec3f4db1af0b8dd0.gif

This should be the first status report, the next one will deal a little more with the jobs that are currently available.
I hope you enjoyed this little report, feel free to comment if you have any feedback or would like to say something in general.

Until then
Your ReDz
